notes: 148-page PDF (printed pages 1–148 after cover/changelog). Many cyber (CyberGym, Cybench bars, private CTF, Incalmo), honesty (HF win rates, 100Q-Hard/Simple-QA, false-premise), Gray Swan ART, and alignment auditor results are figure-only without readable numbers in pdftotext—those charts were skipped. Context window is not stated as a model product limit (200k appears only as a CyberGym eval harness setting). Helpful-only snapshots were used for some CBRN results (noted in captions). Cap kept well under 600 by focusing on tables and prose-stated scores. Quote matching ignores whitespace/punctuation.
